paper.title: Parsimonious mixtures of multivariate contaminated normal distributions

code.archive: ContaminatedMixt 1.0, CRAN archive, Packaged 2015-12-20; sha256 5b1cd5ea32712e748d817128ff52f5343ebf9228b682ce70cb38b9086869448e. Paper cites ContaminatedMixt (Punzo et al. 2015), so 1.0 is the contemporaneous release. Dataset wine.RData is bundled in the package (data/wine.RData).

claim.where: Section 7.3 (Wine data), Table 11, row 'CNMs': best family member by BIC over G in {1,2,3,4} and the 14 parsimonious covariance structures of the CNM family.
claim.value: G = 3, parsimonious structure EEE (CNMs row of Table 11)
claim.metric: BIC-selected (G, structure) within the CNM family, on the 178 x 13 wine data with labels ignored
claim.tolerance: exact match on G and structure label (categorical; no numeric tolerance applies)
claim.tolerance_reason: The output is a discrete model label, so a numeric tolerance has no meaning; any other label is a non-reproduction.
claim.seed_note: The paper reports no seed for the EM starts (Section 5.2 initialisation is random). The scout fixes seed 1 before any run; the paper's value is the reference, the seed is the scout's pre-registration.

cost.basis: 14 structures x 4 values of G on 178 x 13 data; each ECM fit is seconds; the paper notes some fits fail numerically, which the rerun records rather than hides
cost.data_size: 178 rows x 13 columns (bundled in the package)
cost.data_licence: Wine data of Forina et al. (1998) via the gclus package; bundled in ContaminatedMixt (GPL-2 or later); the package licence applies

why: A discrete BIC-selected model label from a real dataset, computed end to end by the package's CNmixt routine, with the source of the value located in Table 11 of the arXiv v5 text.
